name: Temazepam

tolerance.full: within a couple of days of continuous use

toxicities: potentially lethal when mixed with depressants like alcohol or opioids
summary: Temazepam's brand name is Restoril. It is a hypnotic benzodiazepine with effects similar to clonazepam, frequently prescribed as a sleep aid. Some users report mild euphoria alongside the hypnotic effects.
metabolism: Mainly cleared by conjugation to inactive products, including an O-conjugate, followed by urinary excretion. No active metabolites were identified in the cited human disposition study.
